frase_gancho.texto: Sacred mountain ranges where ritual chants and peyote weave the order of the universe.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Step into the mystical geography of the Sierra Madre Occidental, ancestral home of the Cora, Wixárika (Huichol), Tepehuan, and Nahuatl peoples. This gallery immerses visitors in a worldview deeply bound to nature, where ritual pilgrimages to the desert of Wirikuta and the ceremonial centers sustain the cosmic balance. As you walk through the exhibits, you will admire the meticulous beadwork creations, the sacred gourd bowls, and the fine textiles made on the backstrap loom. The narrative highlights the continued vitality of the mitote and the festivals of the agricultural cycle, showing how aesthetic and spiritual devotion sustains community life.
